description: Follow rugby with API-Rugby: games and results with the score by half and while they are played, standings, team season statistics, head-to-head records and bookmakers' pre-match odds, for more than 140 leagues and cups, from the Top 14, the Premiership and the United Rugby Championship to Super Rugby, the Six Nations, the Champions Cup and the World Cup. Needs an API-SPORTS key; the free plan allows 100 requests a day.
